switcher.title: Choose a Space
switcher.emptyDescription: Spaces you create or join appear here.

create.title: Create a Space
create.namePlaceholder: Enter a name for the Space

general.title: General
general.description: Members and people you invite see this information.

members.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name{'@'}company.com.
members.emptyMembersDescription: People who accept an invitation appear here.
members.emptyInvitesDescription: Invitations you send stay here until they are accepted.
members.inviteSentDescription: {email} will get an email with the link.
members.memberRemovedDescription: This person no longer has access to the Space.
members.inviteRoleUpdatedDescription: The person joins with the new role when they accept.
members.inviteRemovedDescription: The link in the email no longer works.

danger.title: Delete Space
danger.description: Deleting a Space removes it for every member, and it can't be undone.
danger.confirmDescription: Delete the {name} Space? Its members lose access and this can't be undone.

invite.title: Space invitation
invite.message: You were invited to join this Space as {role}.
invite.notFoundDescription: This invitation doesn't exist or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This invitation doesn't exist or was sent to another email address. Sign in with the address that received it.
errors.CONFLICT: You are already a member of this Space.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This Space has reached the member limit of its plan. Ask an owner of the Space to free a seat or change the plan.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to accept the invitation.
errors.UNKNOWN: The invitation couldn't be accepted. Try again in a moment.
